title: Loose note (memo, research log, ad-hoc record)
description: Stores reference information that is not managed as a decision, an implementation change or a work item.

topic.description: A single label coarser than tags (e.g. 'auth-flow', 'perf-investigation').

summary.description: A summary of 1-2 sentences. It lets a human/agent grasp the note from the index.

expires.description: The date on which the note is expected to become stale. Once it has passed, it is input for deciding to move to status: archived.

record_type.description: The record type of the dev-evidence history producer contract. When specified, subject_paths is required.

subject_paths.description: The subjects of the record (repo-relative paths). dev-evidence aggregates them into the history view.

outcome.description: A short conclusion (refuted / confirmed for debug, fixed / filed and so on for a finding).
